identity_definition: Context node = base.transition_id; outcome node = obs.transition_id. Roles are separate even when the same ID appears on both sides. This does not establish unique pixels, action inputs, or actual UI states across IDs.

forest_additive_test_label_construction.scope: Diagnostic test-label identity lookup; not train/test generalization, a deployable classifier, or the released model's learned readout.
forest_additive_test_label_construction.labels: Positive edge target +1; negative edge target -1.
forest_additive_test_label_construction.algorithm: If the simple bipartite graph is a forest and duplicate-edge labels agree, anchor the lexicographically first vertex of each component at zero. Traverse its tree; assign unseen neighbor potential = edge target - current potential. Each edge then satisfies u(context)+v(outcome)=target.

native_aggregate_metric_definitions.note: These average pairwise AUCs; graph statistics are reported for their actual component comparisons, without inventing a new pooled binary target.

verified_native_head.feature_formula: concat(unit(mean observed_j)-unit(mean predicted_i), mean valid action tokens_i)
verified_native_head.head: Fixed StandardScaler followed by LogisticRegression; no absolute residual or joint residual L2 normalization.
verified_native_head.logit_formula: L_ij = beta_o^T o_j - beta_o^T p_i + beta_a^T a_i + c = u_i + v_j
verified_native_head.mixed_contrast: L_11 - L_12 - L_21 + L_22 = 0 in exact arithmetic; numerical rounding may leave small residuals. Sigmoid probabilities need not have zero mixed contrast.
verified_native_head.interpretation: Outcome score ordering cannot reverse with context. A complete checkerboard cannot be classified correctly at all four cells by a common threshold.

integrity_exception.scope: This score has a context-outcome interaction and is not subject to the additive harm-head limitation. No full-verifier bypass follows.

conclusions: At official transition-ID resolution the test graph is a forest, with no complete 2x2 panel. The diagnostic additive lookup construction fits its binary labels exactly.
Donor pairing excludes outcome-only detection for RSWT but does not by itself identify context-outcome interactions over additive effects.
The construction uses test labels and unrestricted ID potentials. It neither reproduces the learned head nor measures held-out generalization, so its exact fit is not a performance baseline.
The linear-head expressivity fact is elementary; the source-grounded benchmark qualification is useful but is not evidence of a new security mechanism or actual agent harm.
A model pilot needs independently grounded complete relational comparisons and a concrete consumer consequence; downloading the WM merely to verify the algebra is unnecessary.
limitations: Different transition IDs may contain identical images or actions. Image deduplication and actual input equivalence were not inspected.
No missing edge has been assigned a safe/harmful label. A structurally completed matrix does not supply safety ground truth.
The native score CLI reports scores; this audit does not establish a downstream accept/block policy or physical consequence.
